release_notes: Introduced a dedicated Android full-screen player with advanced touch gestures
Added responsive mobile navigation and categorized media browsing
Added asynchronous media thumbnails and smooth video transitions
Improved accessibility with full system text scaling support
Fixed missing translations and improved Arabic and English localization
Improved light theme contrast and dynamic visual consistency
Optimized playlist selection, scrolling, and media event processing
Improved memory management, resource cleanup, and application stability
Enhanced playlist synchronization across M3U, XSPF, and local storage
Improved update security, installation reliability, and network diagnostics
Improved error logging and removed silent exception handling
Improved overall performance, reliability, and cross-platform compatibility
Verified production stability with 74/74 automated tests passing and zero analysis issues
